name: Kristian Ventura
biography: Karl Kristian Flores, known professionally as Kristian Ventura, is an actor known for his role as Simon Elroy in the Paramount+ drama series School Spirits on Netflix. He is the author of the novel ‘A Happy Ghost,’ and has received esteemed awards as a leader for international service and volunteering. Kristian was raised in the Bay Area and lives in Los Angeles. He studied acting and literature at the University of Southern California.
